title: What Were You Doing?
intro: What were you doing yesterday at six o'clock?

parentTip.vi: Buổi tối hỏi con: "What were you doing at five o'clock?" và gợi ý trả lời "I was playing…".
parentTip.say: What were you doing at five o'clock?

chat.ask: Were you sleeping at eleven o'clock last night?

gaps.s: I was ___ a book when Mum called me.
Dad was ___ dinner in the kitchen.
At midnight, everybody was ___ in bed.

text.title: When the Lights Went Out
lines: Last night, at eight o'clock, all the lights in our house went out.
Mum was cooking dinner, and Dad was reading the newspaper.
My little sister was painting a picture, and I was singing in the bath!
Then Dad found a torch, and we ate dinner in the dark.

options: the child who tells the story
